Definition
[second fundamental form]

Source: petersen:page-0108, petersen:page-0109

For a hypersurface $H^{n-1}\subset M^n$ with fixed unit normal field $N:H o T^\perp H=\{ v\in T_pM\mid p\in H,\, v\perp T_pH\} $, the second fundamental form is the $(0,2)$-tensor $\Pi (X,Y)=g( abla _XN,Y)$ on $H$.
Proof

↗ def:pet-ch3-second-fundamental-form

\sketch Starting from subsection 2.1, metric compatibility and torsion-freeness give, for tangent $X,Y$,

\[ g( abla _XN,Y)=-g(N, abla _XY) =-g(N, abla _YX)=g( abla _YN,X), \]

because $[X,Y]$ is tangent. Also $g( abla _XN,N)= frac 12Xg(N,N)=0$, so $ abla _XN$ is tangent.
